use default

is_prime(n: int) -> bool is
    if n < 2 then
        return false
    fi

    if n % 2 == 0 then
        return n == 2
    fi

    let divisor mut = 3

    while divisor * divisor <= n do
        if n % divisor == 0 then
            return false
        fi

        divisor = divisor + 2
    od

    true
si

write_line((1::50) |> filter(is_prime) |> join(", "))
